source.title: Open problems collected from the spring topology and dynamical systems conference 2006

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 5232466. The zbMATH REST API /v1/document/5232466 resolved the record as Zbl identifier 1132.54300, title 'Open problems collected from the spring topology and dynamical systems conference 2006', editor/author Jerry E. Vaughan, Topology Proceedings 31(1), pages 379-401, 2007.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged and network_or_dns_failure. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/5232466 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The exact-work PDF candidates https://topology.nipissingu.ca/tp/reprints/v31/tp31132.pdf and https://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/document?doi=c9271a31194cccc2143f50cbb1651c5cd8ff6c21&repid=rep1&type=pdf were found by exact-title search and matched the resolver metadata, but local curl downloads failed because the sandbox has no DNS configuration. Browser opens of the PDF URLs did not expose a readable full-text artifact.

Additional exact-work recovery attempts included the Topology Proceedings volume page https://topology.nipissingu.ca/tp/reprints/v31/r2.htm, the historical conference/source URL http://www.uncg.edu/mat/stdc, and a Jina reader attempt for the exact PDF URL. These did not yield readable full PDF or HTML text in this environment. Search snippets showing portions of the PDF were rejected as technical evidence because the workflow forbids extraction from search snippets.

No readable primary PDF or HTML full-text artifact was established, so section mapping and candidate extraction were not run. Resolver metadata and snippets were used only for identity and failure classification, not for open-problem extraction.

Extraction stopped before candidate generation because the exact work could not be normalized to a readable full-text source. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/5232466.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
